purpose: Freeze and audit a causal ETH perpetual 15-minute Pine strategy derived from the supplied ALLIN-V7.2 rules.

instrument.tradingview_label: ETHUSDT.P (venue must be selected and exported explicitly)
instrument.contract_note: The local OKX series is a research proxy; it is not asserted bar-identical to an unspecified TradingView ETHUSDT.P venue.

time_contract.final_preholdout_status: already consumed for this research family; not an unseen OOS set

frozen_execution.entry: confirmed signal close t, market fill at open t+1
frozen_execution.initial_stop: min(4 * Pine ATR14, 3% of signal close), rounded to one-cent ticks, anchored to actual entry fill
frozen_execution.break_even: after a completed bar reaches +1.5%, stop locks +0.1% for the next bar
frozen_execution.opposite_signal: single reversal; no duplicate close order

signal_contract.project_direction_feature: slow_slope_12 = EMA200 / EMA200[12] - 1; positive for long, negative for short
signal_contract.percentile_guard: require p99(difference) > 0; no historical ETH signal changed in the bounded sample

chronology: project slow_slope_12 sign gate selected on 2023/2024
slope lag 72 selected in development but rejected by its single final-preholdout evaluation
oscillator threshold 0.1 selected from the 0.1-0.15 robust plateau for higher sample coverage and weighted expectancy, then evaluated once on final pre-holdout
density, one-bar confirmation, cooldown removal, break-even removal and trailing families rejected in development/confirmation
selection_log.multiple_testing_warning: The final-preholdout period has been inspected. All future variants are post-selection hypotheses until fresh forward evidence or an owner-authorized holdout evaluation.

matched_control.inference: UTC-week block sign-flip plus week bootstrap

l2_contract.reason: The frozen LightGBM is a short-side YOLO-v10 model with different candidate and label semantics; active_bundle.json is absent and new training is blocked by P0/P1.
l2_contract.output: Export all 28 causal project feature columns at Pine signal bars as a training-ineligible research table.
